sub_sector.value: lithium-ion battery packs and energy storage systems for commercial vehicles

manufacturing_type.detail: Vertically integrated: makes cathode, anode, electrolyte, then cells, modules and packs.

production_model.detail: Designs and customizes chemistry, cells, modules and packs to customers' applications.

product_complexity.detail: High energy density, ultra-fast charging, long cycle life, built-in safety batteries.

production_role.detail: Supplies battery packs and cells to vehicle and equipment makers; also energy storage systems.

end_market_exposure.detail: Transportation, heavy equipment electrification and energy storage systems.
